topics.name: Final Project Planning
notes: - 先写一页需求：用户是谁、要解决什么问题、成功标准如何衡量。
- 画出架构：入口 API、LangGraph 图（节点/边/state）、工具与数据源、持久化、观测。
- 里程碑：先做最小可用版本（单 agent + 1~2 个工具），再逐步加入 RAG、多 agent、人工审批。
- 同时准备评估数据集，从第一个版本开始记录基线分数。
- 明确不做什么，控制范围。

topics.name: Final Project Review
notes: - 功能：核心场景可用，错误有友好提示。
- 质量：评估数据集分数达标，没有明显回归。
- 可观测：开启 trace，关键指标有看板和告警。
- 安全：密钥不入库，工具最小权限，高风险操作有人工确认。
- 可靠：超时、重试、限流和降级已配置。
- 文档：架构图、运行方式、已知限制和后续计划。

questions.title: What should be defined first when planning the final project?

options.text: The user problem and the success criteria
The number of agents
The color of the UI
The model with the most parameters

questions.explanation: Without a clear problem and measurable success criteria you cannot decide on architecture or tell whether the project works.

questions.title: Which build order is recommended for the project?

options.text: Start with a minimal single agent and a few tools, then add RAG, multi-agent or approvals as needed
Start with a multi-agent system with every feature
Build the UI first and the agent last
Skip evaluation until launch

questions.explanation: A small working version gives a baseline. Add complexity only when evaluation shows it is needed.

questions.title: Which belong in the architecture plan of an agent project?

options.text: Graph design: nodes, edges and state
Persistence such as a checkpointer
Observability and tracing
The app icon color

questions.explanation: These shape correctness, scalability and operability of the agent.

questions.title: Which check best shows that a change did not make the agent worse?

options.text: Run the evaluation dataset and compare the scores with the baseline
Try one example by hand
Check that the code compiles
Read the prompt again

questions.explanation: Comparing scores over many examples catches regressions that a single manual try would miss.

questions.title: Which items belong on a pre-release security checklist?

options.text: Secrets are not stored in the repository
Tools run with least privilege
High-risk actions require human approval
Full personal data is logged in every trace

questions.explanation: Traces and logs should avoid secrets and personal data, not collect them.

questions.title: What is the best way to handle known limitations of the finished project?

options.text: Document them with a plan for follow-up work
Hide them from users and teammates
Remove the project documentation
Wait until they cause an incident

questions.explanation: Documented limitations set expectations and become the backlog for the next iteration.
